title: 最后一枚

coin-roll.method: 取 Sunburst 原画中完整的同一枚币，沿地面平移经过鞋尖；角色使用两幅完整姿势。

editing_notes: 滚币段以同一枚原画硬币移动经过脚前，接回伸手去捡的完整姿势。

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: One silver-haired girl, simple paper sticker, exaggerated blank circular eyes and purple sleeveless workout costume. Turns out her pocket, a single coin drops, rolls past; eyes track it, delayed aghast reaction, bends down out of crop to recover, returns upright. No markings/text on coin.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.0 s: Draw a silver-haired girl with huge blank circular eyes and a purple sleeveless workout costume as a simple paper sticker; her right hand rests inside her right pocket, and her left hand rests on her hip. 2) 0.5 s: She pulls her right pocket inside out with her right hand while her left steadies the waistband; one plain, unmarked coin drops from the pocket. 3) 1.0 s: The coin lands on its edge near the lower center and rolls right; she tips her face downward to track it, keeping both hands on the pocket and waistband. 4) 1.5 s: The coin rolls through the lower-right foreground toward the crop edge; her head turns farther right, her blank eyes following, while her expression stays neutral. 5) 2.1 s: The coin has rolled out of view; she finally opens her mouth in aghast disbelief, raises her shoulders, and freezes with both hands still holding their previous positions. 6) 2.7 s: She releases the pocket and bends toward the lower-right foreground, reaching down with her right hand while her left hand slides onto her left thigh for support. 7) 3.3 s: Her head, shoulders, and reaching right hand dip below the bottom crop to retrieve the coin; her bent hips and left hand braced on her thigh remain visible. 8) 3.9 s: She returns upright holding the same plain coin between her right thumb and forefinger; her left hand lifts the right pocket opening, and her face points toward the coin. 9) 4.5 s: She presses the coin completely into the restored pocket, leaving her right fingertips at its opening as her left hand releases it and her expression settles.
Continuity: Use one fixed camera and consistent sticker styling throughout a 4.8-second loop, preserving the single coin and hand paths as pose nine flows into the distinct first pose.

strip-0.prompt:
Act as a senior 2D inbetween animator. Return a continuous production sheet in EXACTLY the same layout as this reference: THREE columns, FOUR rows, TWELVE equally sized complete square images, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Fill every square with one fully drawn camera-locked scene. Its white background, screen coordinates, character scale, clothing and props agree with the reference. No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Full story for context: One silver-haired girl, simple paper sticker, exaggerated blank circular eyes and purple sleeveless workout costume. Turns out her pocket, a single coin drops, rolls past; eyes track it, delayed aghast reaction, bends down out of crop to recover, returns upright. No markings/text on coin.
A = 0.0 s: Draw a silver-haired girl with huge blank circular eyes and a purple sleeveless workout costume as a simple paper sticker; her right hand rests inside her right pocket, and her left hand rests on her hip.
B = 0.5 s: She pulls her right pocket inside out with her right hand while her left steadies the waistband; one plain, unmarked coin drops from the pocket.
C = 1.0 s: The coin lands on its edge near the lower center and rolls right; she tips her face downward to track it, keeping both hands on the pocket and waistband.
Trust the actual illustrated poses in the attachment for the shape, timing and exact action. Preserve figure count and source costume. Never place hands, limbs or extra flowers into adjacent cells.
